eb2tn3t9e3bh.speaker: narr
eb2tn3t9e3bh.text: You crouched next to Sovann and moved the spatula. The dry soil crumbled softly away.
eb2tn3t9e3bh.heard: You crouched next to Sovann and moved the spatula. The dry soil crumbled softly away.
eb2tn3t9e3bh.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1xxnqay6w7mm.speaker: narr
e1xxnqay6w7mm.text: You put some soil in a sieve and shook it. A small piece of pottery was left behind.
e1xxnqay6w7mm.heard: You put some soil in a sieve and shook it. A small piece of pottery was left
e1xxnqay6w7mm.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1mp82w71uty5.speaker: sovann
e1mp82w71uty5.text: That's an important clue, too. Let's record it.
e1mp82w71uty5.heard: That's an important clue, too. Let's record it.
e1mp82w71uty5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e8p1tb1i57r.speaker: nekmax

e10lufm9pajn7.speaker: bopha
e10lufm9pajn7.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e14rtoc51n5ga.speaker: narr
e14rtoc51n5ga.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eh4ird51e5sx.speaker: narr
eh4ird51e5sx.text: The tip of Sovann's spatula hit something hard.
eh4ird51e5sx.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1lqz0md1e97x.speaker: narr
e1lqz0md1e97x.text: Gently, gently, he swept the soil away with a brush. From the gray stone, a pair of closed eyes and a calm mouth appeared.
e1lqz0md1e97x.heard: Gently, he swept the soil away with a brush. From the gray stone, a pair of closed eyes and a calm mouth appeared.
e1lqz0md1e97x.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

emxcfb11y5a0.speaker: sovann
emxcfb11y5a0.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eb7k6e4fhbkk.speaker: narr
eb7k6e4fhbkk.text: As they dug further, Buddha statues appeared, one after another. Some were big; some were as small as the palm of your hand.
eb7k6e4fhbkk.heard: As they dug further, Buddha statues appeared, one after another. Some were big; some were as small as the palm of your hand.
eb7k6e4fhbkk.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e7ewxnppgoll.speaker: narr
e7ewxnppgoll.text: Many of them showed the Buddha sitting on a snake god. On some, the head had come away from the body.
e7ewxnppgoll.heard: Many of them showed the Buddha sitting on a snake god. On some, the head had come away from the body.
e7ewxnppgoll.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1k0uwx0vkyyr.speaker: narr
e1k0uwx0vkyyr.text: Each time another Buddha appeared, the trainees quietly put their hands together.
e1k0uwx0vkyyr.heard: Each time another Buddha appeared, the trainees quietly put their hands together.
e1k0uwx0vkyyr.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1iqis8x1lhh1.speaker: sovann
e1iqis8x1lhh1.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1umydnl1bcfd.speaker: narr
e1umydnl1bcfd.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eci8doqidpb.speaker: sovann
eci8doqidpb.text: For hundreds of years, they've been here, with no one finding them…
eci8doqidpb.heard: For hundreds of years, they've been here, with no one finding them.
eci8doqidpb.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1n83tosudgyt.speaker: sovann
e1n83tosudgyt.text: People of our own country found them — with our own hands.
e1n83tosudgyt.heard: People of our own country found them — with our own hands.
e1n83tosudgyt.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e77qjc1ck55z.speaker: sovann
e77qjc1ck55z.text: But… why were so many Buddha statues buried here?
e77qjc1ck55z.heard: But… why were so many Buddha statues
e77qjc1ck55z.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1epbic5pg9o4.speaker: sovann
e1epbic5pg9o4.text: Were they broken and thrown away? Or did someone bury them carefully to keep them safe?
e1epbic5pg9o4.heard: Were they broken and thrown away? Or did someone bury them carefully to keep them safe?
e1epbic5pg9o4.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1uf9zuh1tshc.speaker: sovann
e1uf9zuh1tshc.text: …I'd like to think so too. But finding out for sure — that's our job.
e1uf9zuh1tshc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ez0o5lv1mqbu.speaker: sovann
ez0o5lv1mqbu.text: That's true. Being able to say “we don't know” when we don't know — that's part of research, too.
ez0o5lv1mqbu.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

en6cu1w1dhbe.speaker: nekmax
en6cu1w1dhbe.text: …We're back. This is Banteay Kdei today.
en6cu1w1dhbe.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ugdi5ev5gxt.speaker: nekmax
e1ugdi5ev5gxt.text: In 2001, Cambodian trainees in the middle of their training dug up Buddha statues at this temple. In all, 274 statues and pieces of statues were found.
e1ugdi5ev5gxt.heard: In 2001, Cambodian trainees in the middle of their training dug up Buddha statues at this temple. In all, 274 statues and pieces of statues were found.
e1ugdi5ev5gxt.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e94ajchwz06f.speaker: nekmax
e94ajchwz06f.text: They say it was the first time so many Buddha statues had been found in one place.
e94ajchwz06f.heard: They say it was the first time so many Buddha statues had been found in one place.
e94ajchwz06f.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e16tinbl1wsmg.speaker: nekmax
e16tinbl1wsmg.text: The biggest are about 1.8 meters tall, and the smallest about 20 centimeters. They had been broken, but they were buried with great care.
e16tinbl1wsmg.heard: The biggest are about 1.8 meters tall, and the smallest about 20 centimeters. They had been broken, but they were buried with great care.
e16tinbl1wsmg.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e149f15t1bc1r.speaker: nekmax
e149f15t1bc1r.text: Even now, no one knows who buried them, or why.
e149f15t1bc1r.heard: Even now, no one knows who buried them, or why.
e149f15t1bc1r.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ea4p16tgr9ia.speaker: nekmax
ea4p16tgr9ia.text: This training has been run since the early 1990s by a research team from Sophia University in Japan.
ea4p16tgr9ia.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e9c4sdd190r8.speaker: nekmax
e9c4sdd190r8.text: Yoshiaki Ishizawa, who led the team, later described it like this.
e9c4sdd190r8.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ik9uyssfx8g.speaker: nekmax
e1ik9uyssfx8g.text: Each time a statue was found, the trainees put their hands together before it. Then, with trembling hands, they cleaned off the mud with bamboo spatulas and brushes.
e1ik9uyssfx8g.heard: Each time a statue was found, the trainees put their hands together before it. Then, with trembling hands, they cleaned off the mud with bamboo spatulas and brushes.
e1ik9uyssfx8g.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e3tadbl1cr5h.speaker: nekmax
e3tadbl1cr5h.text: Cambodians who learned through this training are now at the heart of the work to restore Angkor.
e3tadbl1cr5h.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1mcxcpl1k0e1.speaker: nekmax
e1mcxcpl1k0e1.text: You can see the statues that were found at the Preah Norodom Sihanouk–Angkor Museum in Siem Reap.
e1mcxcpl1k0e1.heard: You can see the statues that were found at the Preah Norodom Sihanouk–Angkor Museum in Siem Reap.
e1mcxcpl1k0e1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1fopm0z1r7f3.speaker: nekmax
e1fopm0z1r7f3.text: There really were young people who studied so they could protect their country's ruins with their own hands.
e1fopm0z1r7f3.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e10i9tm6189v4.speaker: nekmax
e10i9tm6189v4.text: (whispering) The Buddhas waited in the earth for hundreds of years. …I'm glad they were found.
e10i9tm6189v4.heard: The Buddhas waited in the earth for hundreds of years. …I'm glad
e10i9tm6189v4.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で
